name: Guanghua School of Management, Peking University (Guanghua Global MBA)

program.format: 2-year full-time Global MBA, English-taught, September intake

tuition_total.note: 'Guanghua Global MBA Program (Full-time / Taught in English) Tuition: 188,000 RMB for the whole program'. Same figure on the PKU 2026 admission notice (https://isd.pku.edu.cn/en/detail.php?id=767). Part-time Chinese-taught MBA: RMB 428,000.

mandatory_fees_total.note: No other mandatory fee listed; non-refundable application fee RMB 800.

living_budget_total.note: No living budget or accommodation cost published on the pages read.

scholarship.note: Guanghua Excellence Scholarship up to RMB 188,000 (full tuition waiver); Beijing Municipal Government Scholarship RMB 10,000-50,000; Need-Based Scholarship RMB 50,000-100,000; Female Leadership Scholarship RMB 50,000-100,000; CSR scholarship (amount not read). Share of students aided not published.

employment.notes: No current employment report published. The English CDC 'Report' page only links 2018 and 2019 reports (EmploymentRepEN2019.pdf, 21 MB; download truncated, and too old to use). The Chinese CDC page 'jiuye baogao' (https://www.gsm.pku.edu.cn/cdc/gzfw/jybg.htm) lists 0 reports. Career Prospects page gives no figures. Not usable for ROI until a report is found (possibly on the school's WeChat account, not readable here).

profile.cohort: current Global MBA students (year not stated)
profile.note: Read from an infographic image on the page: 15+ countries and regions, 6 years average work experience, 29 average age; 73% bachelor's / 27% master's; pre-MBA industry: finance/banking/securities/VC/insurance 43%, electronics/IT/internet 18%, consulting/training/legal 15%, construction/real estate 7%, manufacturing 5%, transport/logistics 3%, aerospace 3%, healthcare 3%, retail 3%.

rankings_cited.note: No school page found; rank 14 from a ClearAdmit FT 2026 table (and Poets&Quants, 2026-02-18) seen via search/WebFetch. Third-party extract: re-check on an official school page if possible.

notes: Global MBA is a small English-taught track; the large Chinese-taught MBA is a separate programme.
